admission.justification: Realized in dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoFrameControl.ts, where arm posts the agent-naming problem for the unanswered target with one fallback load, and in dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoFrameModel.ts, where agentTimeoutText states whether the fallback loads the agent page or the frame already names it.

applicability: A wanted but unsettled selection whose ready-after-load or request answer is overdue, on document and Chats pages.
conditions: A first deadline probes the application; only an unanswered ping deadline declares silence and permits fallback.
The fallback sentence reflects whether the loaded identity already names the selected agent.
A pong preserves/reestablishes readiness and a responsive late answer remains waiting.
exclusions: Unselected panes, which name nothing by construction.

evidence: PaseoChatFrame.test.tsx document page: no-ready naming, no-target silence, chats-page single fallback load with truthful sentence

statement: Ready-after-load or agent-answer timeout sends ping. Only its unanswered deadline names the unsettled agent and states whether the URL fallback loaded its page or already named it. A pong preserves/reestablishes readiness; a slow answer remains a named waiting state with explicit Retry and no automatic load.
